svg.text: Local documents: which files are read, and how
files.py decides which files; zetokrag/parse.py turns one into text; the index, the tools and the extracted-text store share both. working tree on 5ca550a, 2026-10-12.
the outermost only: a nested folder walked once
5 made by a tool: pyvenv.cfg, conda-meta/,
6 a hidden name: left out unless included
More than 500 files side by side?
yes → its files left out (likely a dataset),
unless the folder is declared or included
protected, or a link leading outside: counted
then the user's patterns, a hidden name,
a type parse does not read → 'unsupported'
a folder once, not each file in it
over 20 MiB → too_large · a NUL byte → binary
a byte order mark → UTF-8, 16 or 32
normalizer), kept if its language is recognized
or ≥ 64 bytes without rare characters; NFC
else UTF-8 with replacement; the note says which
no text on any page → needs_ocr (no OCR yet)
PyMuPDF's own order: columns read one by one
lines in the top or bottom 7.5% found on half
the pages, digits aside → dropped (heads, numbers)
a glyph without a character → U+FFFD
limit: 20 M characters of text, not bytes
a code cell's text outputs, ≤ 2,000 characters
a block: text, unit (line, page, cell), start
lines end at \n only (parse.lines), as editors,
PDFs, notebooks, text not in UTF-8, as UTF-8
one file per content, copies share it; 0600
each block from a new line; units map a line
back to its page, cell or line (locate)
every update: missing written, the rest removed
read: parse.read, same text and lines
grep: ripgrep over the files and the store,
the converter for what the index has not seen
a file changed since indexing is decoded
Docker, CPU only, not root, POSIX locale
The extension picks one of the three; each ends in a Doc.
working tree on 5ca550a, 2026-10-12; their state is kept in STATUS.md
grep walks the folders on every call (files.walk: 1.1–1.4 s of 2.2 s for 13,402 files on the owner's machine); speed on a large corpus and on macOS or
encoding guess: a text under 64 bytes whose language is not recognized is read with replacement characters (said in the note); cp1252 and cp1250
PDF reading order measured on 10 LaTeX arXiv papers only (prose of 69 two-column pages right); Word, scanned and vertical CJK layouts not
measured; no OCR in the first version (needs_ocr is reported)
Word, PowerPoint, Excel and HTML have text readers; complex visual layouts remain unverified; .csv, .json, .log are read and grepped by the tools but
level B checked on Linux only (clean Docker image, CPU, not root, POSIX locale); macOS, Windows (junctions, cloud-synced placeholders) not checked
